- Keep the first session strictly 30 minutes (exec-level highlights + 3 curated use cases)
- Offer an optional follow-up 30-min technical Q&A the same week (Rishi will lead)

- Any PO terms or contract start date constraints
- Security contact for a brief checklist (network egress, retention, SOC2 attestation)

If you prefer a different day/time we can be flexible — just flag your preferred timezone.
